app_action_failed: The action could not be completed
app_page_error_help: Check your connection and try again.
app_page_forbidden_help: Your account does not have permission for this page.
auth_network_error: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
auth_signin_error: Could not sign in. Check your email and password.
auth_signup_description: Enter your name, email and password.
auth_signup_error: Could not create an account. Check your details or sign in.
auth_switch_signin: Already have an account? Sign in
a11y_speech_help: Read aloud requires a local voice for the selected language. Text stays on your device.
a11y_speech_unavailable: Read aloud is unavailable in this browser.
home_description: Meeting transcripts, action items and summaries in one workspace.
home_status: Recording processing is not connected yet.
player_error_help: Could not play this recording. Check access and file format, then try again.
player_play_blocked: The browser blocked playback. Press Play again.
player_local_help: Audio and an existing transcript open only in this browser and are not uploaded. Speech recognition does not run on this page.
player_empty: Choose a file to listen to a recording.
player_transcript_help: Choose the WAV used by the local model and its JSON transcript. SHA-256 verifies the match; text stays in the browser. Automatic transcription may contain errors.
player_transcript_mismatch: This transcript belongs to a different audio file. Choose the WAV supplied to the local model, not the original MP3.
player_transcript_too_large: File too large: transcript limit 8 MiB, audio verification limit 256 MiB.
transcript_follow_on: Following the current segment. Scroll the text to pause following.
transcript_follow_off: Following is off. Enable it to return to the current segment.
transcript_empty: No timed segments for this recording and result version.
transcript_demo_help: Synthetic data only. Eight tones start every four seconds; each lasts three seconds, followed by silence. Click a segment or task source to seek without changing play/pause. No audio or text is uploaded.
transcript_demo_segment: Signal {number} · {frequency} Hz. This is a synthetic transcript marker.
transcript_demo_action_text: Compare signals 3 and 7. The buttons use source_segment_ids; an unavailable reference is disabled.
capture_description: Only audio you select is recorded. This does not join Teams, Meet or Zoom as a separate participant.
capture_transport_disconnected: After stopping, you can save the recording on your server. AI processing is not running yet.
capture_save_error: Could not save the recording. The local copy remains here.
capture_saved: Recording saved on the server. Status: {status}.
capture_browser_help: HTTPS or localhost is required. Select a source in the browser picker and enable audio sharing. Tab, window and system audio availability depends on your browser and OS; recording cannot start without an audio track. Video is not recorded. Use headphones when mixing sources.
capture_notice: I have permission to record and have notified participants about recording and potential local / self-hosted AI transcription.
capture_silence: No signal or source temporarily muted. Check the selected audio.
capture_error_unsupported: This browser does not support the required capture or format. Use a current browser on HTTPS / localhost.
capture_error_permission: Permission denied or selection cancelled. Allow access and try again.
capture_error_no_audio: The selected source provided no audio track. Enable audio sharing or select the microphone.
capture_error_source_lost: The source stopped. The retained recording is marked incomplete.
capture_error_limit: Local recording limit reached. The continuous prefix was retained; the recording is incomplete.
capture_error_device: Device or recording error. Check permissions and the source; retained audio may be incomplete.
capture_local_result: Listen and download before leaving this page. Closing or refreshing the page loses the recording.
capture_playback_error: The browser could not play this recording. Download the file; an incomplete container may need server recovery.
capture_limits: Local mode: up to 30 minutes, 64 MiB and 4096 chunks. Recording continues locally if the network drops. Changing source requires a new recording.
